//: Copy to projects.json (gitignored) and edit. Nothing here ships as a default — an unconfigured install reports 'not configured' rather than showing someone else's board.
//jiraHost: Your Atlassian site host, no scheme. Per-project `jiraHost` overrides this.
//work: THE MOST LOAD-BEARING SETTING IN THE APP. Every duration — cycle time, lead time, stage budgets, off-hours and weekend-work flags — is measured in working time using these values. Get the weekend wrong and the dashboard will tell you that you work weekends. tzOffsetHours is a fixed UTC offset with no DST handling, so pick the one your team actually works in. weekend and weekStartDay use 0=Sun … 6=Sat.
//storyPointDays: [points, estimated working days] pairs, interpolated between. Org-specific: a '5' means different things at different companies, and estimate-accuracy scoring is only meaningful against your own team's conversion. Delete this key to use the built-in reference table.
//defaultDevEmails: Fallback dev roster for any project that does not set its own `devEmails`. Leave empty rather than guessing — a wrong roster attributes your team's work to other people.
//Almosafer_Tools: Org-specific tool bundle: the Constitution reader (needs a .wakeel/constitution/ knowledge base in the repo) and Figma Capture (ships against a specific design-system catalog). Off by default because both are useless outside the org that has that layout. Hidden from everyone unless this is set. Accepts true, {enabled:true}, or {enabled:true, emails:[...]} to additionally require that the configured JIRA identity matches.
//projects: One entry per JIRA board + GitHub repo. `key` is the JIRA project key. `writes` must be explicitly true before the dashboard will transition a ticket or comment on a PR; the default is copy-to-clipboard.

projects.name: Web Storefront
projects.jql: project = ABC AND (updated >= -180d OR statusCategory != Done) ORDER BY updated DESC
